description: This source file defines a SwiftUI View 'TailscaleIntegrationSection' and related enums and helper methods to manage Tailscale integration settings within a macOS application. It includes configuration management, UI components for user interaction, and logic to read/write configuration files.

classes.name: TailscaleIntegrationSection
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that manages Tailscale configuration UI and interactions.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads Tailscale-related configuration from persistent storage.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Validates and applies the current Tailscale configuration settings, saving them to storage.

methods.name: buildAndSaveTailscaleConfig
methods.description: Builds the Tailscale configuration object and saves it asynchronously.

methods.name: restartGatewayIfNeeded
methods.description: Restarts the gateway process if connected in local mode and gateway is not paused.

methods.name: startStatusTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer to periodically check Tailscale status.

methods.name: stopStatusTimer
methods.description: Stops the periodic status check timer.
